programme.title: The Kid
programme.desc: On the run in the American Southwest, a boy encounters the infamous outlaw Billy the Kid and the legendary lawman Pat Garrett. He soon finds himself caught in the crossfire as Billy and Garrett square off in a deadly game of cat and mouse.

programme.desc: An outcast marshal (Robert Mitchum) and an outlaw (George Kennedy) unite against a cutthroat train robber (David Carradine) in the changing West.

programme.desc: A man (Arthur Kennedy) joins with a gunfighter (Glenn Ford) and a scout (Dean Jagger) to find his wife and children, kidnapped by Apaches.

programme.desc: The son of a notorious gunslinger attempts to bury his reputation and avoid his father's legacy in a small frontier town.

programme.title: Bonanza
